raw_response:
I farm this 0.25 hectare plot with fruit trees and some crops between them, and I learned all this from my father and neighbors. I will not buy chemical fertilizer because one bag costs too much and is more than this small piece needs, but I will carry manure from my cattle and spread it around the trees since the land is mine. I will plant the seed I saved from last year between the trees, and I will pull weeds with my hands rather than buying chemicals. My family will work about 25 days on this plot, and I will not hire anyone.
